linkInvoiceDialog.title: Link an existing inFakt invoice
linkInvoiceDialog.description: Find the invoice for this order in inFakt and paste its UUID. This order will use that invoice instead - no new invoice is created.

clearDialog.title: Allow the invoice to be created again?
clearDialog.descriptionBeforeStrong: Only confirm this if you have checked inFakt and there is
clearDialog.descriptionAfterStrong: invoice for this order. If one exists, this will issue a second one, and undoing that needs a formal corrective invoice.
clearDialog.action: I checked - there is no invoice

skipDialog.title: Do not invoice this order
skipDialog.description: A reason is required and is kept on the record - skipping is a decision not to issue a document you may be required to issue.
skipDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. test order, invoiced manually outside Medusa, duplicate of order ...

reconcile.heading: Adopt existing invoices
reconcile.description: Finds invoices that already exist in inFakt for orders this plugin has no record of, and matches them on the order data alone - the issue date, the buyer and the gross total. It never creates an invoice and never files anything to KSeF. Orders that already have an invoice record are left alone.
reconcile.previewSummary: {{adopt}} of {{scanned}} order(s) matched an invoice in inFakt.
reconcile.previewError: Could not read the reconciliation report.
reconcile.adoptError: Could not adopt the selected invoices.
reconcile.refusedWarning: {{count}} order(s) were not adopted - the match no longer held when the server re-checked it.
reconcile.reportSummary: Scanned {{scanned}} order(s) with no invoice record against {{considered}} invoice(s) in inFakt: {{adopt}} matched, {{ambiguous}} need review, {{noMatch}} found nothing.
reconcile.truncatedWarning: The window held more orders or invoices than one pass reads. Narrow the dates and run it again, or some orders will not have been considered at all.
reconcile.skippedWarning: {{count}} order(s) were skipped because an invoice record already existed for them.
reconcile.nothingToAdopt: Every order in this window already has an invoice record. There is nothing to adopt.

settings.subtitle: Polish invoicing for paid orders.
settings.ksefUnhealthyAlert: The inFakt account has no active KSeF integration, so B2B invoices cannot be filed. Fix it in inFakt, then re-check here.
settings.envForceNotice: forces invoicing off regardless of this switch. Unset it to let the switch above govern again.
settings.configDescription: Changes here apply from the next order onward - no redeploy, no restart needed. A field left unchanged keeps using whatever this plugin was configured with at install.
settings.triggerEventPaymentCaptured: queue once a payment is captured
settings.triggerEventOrderPlaced: queue as soon as the order is placed
settings.ksefModeNipOnly: NIP only - B2B invoices, mandatory in Poland from April 2026
settings.ksefModeNever: Never - development only, breaks the KSeF filing obligation
settings.apiKeyWriteOnly: A previously saved key is never shown here again - only whether one is configured.
settings.apiKeyPlaceholderReplace: Enter a new key to replace the saved one
settings.apiKeyPlaceholderNew: Enter a key to use instead of the installed one
settings.pauseError: Could not change the pause switch.
settings.apiKeyCleared: Saved API key removed. The plugin falls back to the key it was installed with, if there is one.
settings.apiKeyClearError: Could not clear the API key override.
settings.ksefInactive: The KSeF integration is not active.
settings.ksefCheckError: Could not re-check the KSeF integration.
settings.loadError: Could not load the inFakt configuration.
